tools.name: search_titles
tools.description: Find anime, manga or webtoons by title (any language, partial or misspelled is fine). Returns the best matches with year, format, score and the page URL.

tools.name: get_title
tools.description: Full details for one anime, manga or webtoon: synopsis, genres, themes, studios, status, score, where to watch or read (official streaming and reading links), and related entries. Accepts a slug (from search results) or a title.

tools.name: similar_titles
tools.description: Recommendations for one anime, manga or webtoon: "similar by themes" (shared genres and tags) and "people who liked it also liked" (community pairs). Accepts a slug or a title.

tools.name: recommend_from_liked
tools.description: Give 1-10 anime, manga or webtoons the person liked and get recommendations that fit the whole set, with the reason ("because you liked X"). Best tool for "I liked A and B, what should I watch next?".

tools.name: discover_titles
tools.description: Browse the catalog by genre, year, status, format, service and sort order, including webtoons (Korean manhwa, Chinese manhua, WEBTOON and Tapas originals) with webtoon_only and reading platforms in platform. Use list_genres for the genre slugs. Good for "best romance anime", "new isekai manga from 2

tools.name: list_genres
tools.description: The genre slugs accepted by discover_titles.

tools.name: airing_this_week
tools.description: Anime episodes airing in the next 7 days, with episode number and air time (UTC).

tools.name: season_titles
tools.description: All anime of one season (winter, spring, summer, fall) of a year, most popular first. Includes upcoming seasons.

tools.name: resolve_title
tools.description: Given the title of a web page or a messy string (e.g. "Watch Frieren Episode 12 Online - SomeSite"), returns the catalog titles it most likely refers to, best first, with the detected episode or chapter number. Built for browser extensions and agents reading the current page.

tools.name: creator_listing_guide
tools.description: For creators asking where to publish, post or promote their indie manga, webcomic, webtoon, light novel or anime (including after Tapas shut down, or when AniList and MyAnimeList refuse self-published, Western or AI-labelled work). Returns the requirements, steps and links to list or claim a series

tools.name: suggest_feature
tools.description: Sends a feature suggestion or piece of feedback to the AnimeHunt team on the person's behalf. Use when someone wishes the site did something it does not, or wants to report a problem. One sentence title plus optional details.

tools.name: my_library
tools.description: The signed-in person's AnimeHunt library: what they are watching or reading, plan to, finished, with scores and progress. Needs sign-in (see the error text when not signed in).

tools.name: add_to_library
tools.description: Add a title to the signed-in person's AnimeHunt library or move it between shelves (watching/reading = "current", "planning", "completed", "dropped", "paused", "repeating"); optional progress. Needs sign-in.

tools.name: rate_title
tools.description: Give a title a score from 1 to 10 (decimals allowed) in the signed-in person's library; creates the entry as "completed" when it is not there yet. Needs sign-in.

tools.name: write_review
tools.description: Post the signed-in person's review of a title under their name. The review text must be the person's own words (ask them for it; do not write it for them); it is shown with a "via an assistant" label. One review per title; posting again replaces it. Needs sign-in.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_titles, creator_listing_guide · Public sink: creator_listing_guide, write_review · Destructive: search_titles, discover_titles.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_titles, creator_listing_guide · Public sink: creator_listing_guide, write_review · Destructive: search_titles, discover_titles

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
